heading: A little about me
intro: I am a researcher interested in the physical ideas hidden inside living systems.
story: My work sits at the intersection of DNA dynamics, polymer physics, soft matter, microscopy, and quantitative experimentation. I am especially drawn to questions where something enormously complex can be approached through a surprisingly simple physical idea. Outside the laboratory, I photograph nature and ordinary moments, read widely, and follow questions simply because they are interesting.

values.title: Curiosity before certainty
values.description: I would rather begin with a good question than rush toward a neat answer.

values.title: Measure carefully
values.description: Good measurements should clarify a phenomenon rather than hide its uncertainty.

values.title: Look beyond disciplines
values.description: Ideas become especially interesting when biology, physics, materials science, and computation begin to overlap.

timeline.title: PhD candidate
